draft.title: Ways to earn an income
card: Income is money a person receives. People can earn it in several ways, and many people use more than one.
payment for work done for an employer. Wages are often paid by the hour. A salary is a set yearly amount.
Profit is money left over for a business owner after the business pays its costs from its sales. A dividend is a share of a company's profit, paid to the people who own shares in it.
Rent is paid to a person who owns property and lets others use it. Government payments, such as the Age Pension, are paid by the government to eligible people.
draft.remember: Income can come from work, a business, shares, property or government payments.

a.q: Ravi owns shares in a company. The company pays him part of its profit. What type of income is this?
a.why: A dividend is a share of a company's profit paid to the people who own its shares. Ravi has not been paid for working for an employer, so it is not a wage or salary.
a.clue: Ravi gets paid because he owns part of the company.

b.q: Ella owns a flat in Hobart. She lets a student live in it and is paid each week. What type of income does Ella earn?
b.why: Ella owns property and is paid by someone who uses it, so her income is rent. It is not a wage, because she is not paid for working for an employer, and it does not come from the government.
b.clue: Who is paying Ella, and what are they using?
